description: Implementation of Windows-specific X.509 certificate utility functions, including certificate creation, fingerprint calculation, and self-signed verification.

methods.name: CreateX509CertificateFromCertContexts
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a certificate context and optional chain, with safety options.

methods.name: CreateCertContextWithChain
methods.description: Creates a certificate context with chain, with default or specified behavior for invalid intermediates.

methods.name: CalculateFingerprint256
methods.description: Calculates the SHA-256 fingerprint of a certificate context.

methods.name: IsSelfSigned
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is self-signed by verifying its signature and comparing subject and issuer names.
